interpretation: The old 50-step benchmark counted operations and collapses, but did not decrypt per step. The repeated-square route still fails at depth 4 in both secure tuples after fixing canonical K phase. Zero-fresh-error controls with a nontrivial c1 term still fail, while the c1=0 control passes. The two nontrivial controls exhibit a +1 mod t discrepancy at depth 4, but that observation does not justify adding a constant correction. Observed K widths are below the anchor reconstruction widths. These observations narrow the defect but do not identify the first erroneous coefficient or prove a complete BFV noise bound. The separate mul-by-1 depth test has a different input history.
